runs.name: Ambiq Micro, Inc.
runs.entry: The operator's sheet lists the name as AMBI; the company's filings give its NYSE symbol as AMBQ, used for the run and this entry; the done file carries AMBI so the order file matches. Price **$58.56** (close 2026-10-09, aggregator, flagged) x **24,184,536 shares** (one class, 10-Q cover as of 2026-08-07, 0001193125-26-344145; 4,382,484 more reserved for awards) = cap **$1,416M**; sovereign **5.60%** (UST 30Y, 2026-10-09). Primary document the FY2025 10-K (0001193125-26-094004, filed 2026-03-05); cash at 2025-12-31, $140,275K, cross-checked across the 10-K balance sheet, cash flow and the 10-Q. Listed 2025 (IPO at $24.00, 424B4 0001193125-25-169401); FY2020-FY2021 from the 2022 draft registration, FY2023-FY2024 from the 2025 registration; **FY2022 statements never filed publicly**. Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): a fabless ultra-low-power chip designer whose own 10-K says its market will "continually evolve and be subject to rapid technological change" and that "There is no guarantee that our approach to low power will remain competitive"; top five customers 91% of 2025 sales, the largest 2024 customer (41%) under 10% in 2025, Mainland China 50% to 9%; the next family in development; TSMC the only wafer source. Integrity facts recorded, not judged (quarterly guidance; a featured non-GAAP net loss excluding stock pay and depreciation). Q2 to Q12 not reached. Beneath the stop, COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after stock pay, capex and IP-licence purchases negative in every filed year, $(39.9)M / $(58.8)M / not filed / $(32.6)M / $(30.3)M / $(34.0)M for 2020-2025 and $(33.5)M in H1 2026; window average $(38.9)M equity-only, $(40.2)M all-equity; specific (b) gives the no-growth case alone: range $(14.53) a share all-equity ($(28.74) equity-only), fair $(1.46) all-equity ($(16.09) equity-only); on the FY2023-FY2025 base the fair figure is $1.10 against a range of $(9.95), which the analyst names a quirk of the definition, not a price. Balance sheets FY2020-June 2026 (six year-ends, 2022 equity only): funded by owners every year (preferred rounds, the IPO $102.7M net, follow-ons at $31.00 and $78.00 for $243.3M net; shares up 32% in seven months), accumulated deficit $132.8M to $374.0M, no borrowings, no goodwill, cash $366.8M at 2026-06-30. Competitors (facts after the stop, XBRL, not checked to filed statements): gross margin Silicon Labs 53.4-62.7%, Microchip 51.6-67.5%, NXP 49.2-56.9%, Ambiq 29.7-44.4%; operating margin Ambiq (78.3)% to (27.6)%, below Microchip's and NXP's worst year in every year; Infineon, Nordic Semiconductor and Renesas flagged as not SEC filers. Citations: the analyst's check 39 fragments clean; the dispatcher's script (`dispatcher_quote_check.py`) matched 42 and flagged 20, every one a filer quote or a framework or template phrase in the same paragraph before an id, no slip. check_framework PASS. Analyst's gaps for the operator: (1) the fair price misbehaves on negative owner cash (valuing at ten percent shrinks the losses, so fair can sit above the range); a rule is suggested, "where owner cash is negative over the window, no fair price is reported"; (2) a window with an unfiled year (four years averaged, said so); (3) the template's eight to ten balance sheets for a 2025 listing; (4) `tools/run.py` returned UNRESEARCHED for a single-10-K filer.
runs.narr: Listed as AMBI on the operator's sheet, AMBQ on the NYSE. Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): a fabless ultra-low-power chip designer in a field its own 10-K calls subject to rapid technological change, with 91% of sales to five customers that turned over in a year and one foundry. Beneath the stop, owner cash is negative in every filed year (about $(30)M to $(59)M); the literal no-growth range is $(14.53) and fair $(1.46) all-equity against $58.56. Four framework gaps reported (fair price on negative owner cash, an unfiled window year, the balance-sheet count for a new listing, run.py silent).
